from pathlib import Path

s = p.read_text()
old = '''\t\t\tcarryOut := sum / 10
\t\t\tok := false
\t\t\tif column == maxLen-1 {
\t\t\t\tok = carryOut == 0
\t\t\t} else {
\t\t\t\tok = search(column+1, carryOut)
\t\t\t}

\t\t\tassign[idx] = -1
\t\t\tused[want] = false
\t\t\treturn ok
\t\t}
'''
new = '''\t\t\tcarryOut := sum / 10
\t\t\tif column == maxLen-1 {
\t\t\t\tif carryOut == 0 {
\t\t\t\t\t// Successful solution: leave the derived digit in place.
\t\t\t\t\treturn true
\t\t\t\t}
\t\t\t\tsolved = false
\t\t\t} else if search(column+1, carryOut) {
\t\t\t\t// A deeper column solved the puzzle, so keep this
\t\t\t\t// derived digit assigned as well.
\t\t\t\treturn true
\t\t\t}

\t\t\t// This branch failed; undo the tentative result digit before
\t\t\t// trying another combination in the enclosing search level.
\t\t\tassign[idx] = -1
\t\t\tused[want] = false
\t\t\treturn false
\t\t}
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('old block not found')
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
